observations: Photos 0 and 1: front of an inline four-cylinder petrol engine with an aluminium cam cover, crank pulley, idler pulleys, water pump pulley and an alternator on the right.
Photos 0 and 1: a barcode sticker on the cylinder head, only fragments legible ('..A62', '047'); it is not an engine code. A small 'E' sticker on the cam cover.
Photo 2: top view with four open spark plug wells (coils removed), oil filler cap, plastic intake manifold and wiring harness on the left; chalk marks and red and green paint on the cover.
All photos: heavy oil grime, dirt and rust on the engine mount bracket; it sits on a wet concrete floor among other engines.
All photos: watermark 'UCHENNA', a parts dealer's photos.
No photo shows a Toyota logo or the engine code stamped on the block, so neither the brand nor the engine model can be read.
Nothing shows the engine running or the gearbox side, sump or starter.

read_from: photos 0, 1, 2 general shape only; no logo or engine code readable

claims.evidence: Photos show the front and top with alternator, pulleys, intake and harness; coils, sump, starter and the gearbox side are not shown.

claims.claim: For Toyota SUVs and crossovers such as RAV4 second generation XA20

Photos 0, 1, 2 show heavy oil grime, dirt and rust on the mount bracket.

risks.risk: Engine is not the model the seller implies, so it may not fit the buyer's vehicle and its value differs
risks.proof: A sharp photo of the engine code stamped on the block, usually near the gearbox flange
risks.if_unproven: engine model unknown, no comparable can be chosen

risks.risk: Engine does not run, or has low compression or knocking
risks.proof: A clip of the engine running on a stand or in a vehicle, with sound, cold start

risks.risk: Internal damage: sludge, water in oil, worn bearings
risks.proof: A photo of the dipstick and of the oil under the filler cap

risks.risk: Missing parts such as coils, starter or sensors
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides and the bottom of the engine with everything included laid out
risks.if_unproven: as a bare engine with only what is shown

risks.risk: Dealer stock photo, not the exact engine offered
risks.proof: A photo of the engine with a handwritten code and today's date on it

proof_requests: A sharp photo of the engine code stamped on the block
A clip of the engine running with sound
A photo of the engine with a handwritten code and today's date
Photos of the dipstick and under the oil filler cap
Photos of all sides and the bottom showing what is included
response.reason: The photos show a used four-cylinder petrol engine but no logo or engine code is readable, and the engine code is what sets the price and fitment. 'Like new' is contradicted by the grime and rust, so the engine code and a running clip are needed first.
